import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); pairs={k:(G[k+' input'],G[k+' output']) for k in range(1,6)}
print(sorted(pairs))
def f_h(I,A,B,fmode):
    ca=Counter(v for row in A for v in row); cb=Counter(v for row in B for v in row)
    mb=cb.most_common(1)[0][0]; ma=ca.most_common(1)[0][0]
    Q=[[3 if A[r][c]==B[r][c]==mb else mb for c in range(len(A[0]))] for r in range(len(A))]
    return Q
def f_v(I,A,B,fmode):
    mb=Counter(v for row in B for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]; ma=Counter(v for row in A for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    Q=[[3 if A[r][c]==B[r][c]==mb else mb for c in range(len(B[0]))] for r in range(len(A))]
    return Q
for k,(I,O) in sorted(pairs.items()):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); oh,ow=len(O),len(O[0])
    hl=[i for i,r in enumerate(I) if len(set(r))==1]
    vl=[j for j in range(W) if len({I[i][j] for i in range(H)})==1]
    sols=[]
    for s in hl:
        A=[[I[r][c] for c in range(W)] for r in range(s)]; B=[[I[r][c] for c in range(W)] for r in range(s+1,H)]
        Q=f_h(I,A,B,'b'); if Q==O:sols.append(('h',s,Q)); Q=f_h(I,A,B,'a'); if Q==O:sols.append(('h',s,Q))
    for s in vl:
        A=[[I[r][c] for c in range(s)] for r in range(H)]; B=[[I[r][c] for c in range(s+1,W)] for r in range(H)]
        Q=f_v(I,A,B,'b'); if Q==O:sols.append(('v',s,Q)); Q=f_v(I,A,B,'a'); if Q==O:sols.append(('v',s,Q))
    print(k,sols)
